description: One move per call. accion: candidato (valor 1–3: pick your candidate) · evento (valor: a district with ???) · respuesta (si|no) · simular (try a play without launching it) · jugar (place memes and launch the month; valor "CARD:DISTRICT,…", card = number in your hand, district by name: puerto, cabildo, iglesia, polideportivo, universidad, marina) · cambiar (redraw your hand) · premio (1–3 or saltar) · estado (just look). Always send the current paso: a stale step is ignored, so retries are safe. Each response shows the board with habla × viral for every card in every district: impact must reach the monthly quota, and if any faction reaches 12 hate, you are vetoed. — Una acción por llamada; manda siempre el paso actual.
name: corruptopolis_accion
title: Make a move · Hacer una jugada
